evidence_items.finding: owner drawing on personal credit line each time bi-weekly payroll obligations fall due
evidence_items.rationale: Personal credit use for payroll is an acute adverse liquidity signal. financial_health dimension; is_critical=true because payroll dependency on personal credit is an immediate operational solvency signal. Finding paraphrased from symptom — no must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: cash balance depletes sharply when payroll obligations fall due despite growing revenue
evidence_items.rationale: Cash depletion at payroll is an adverse timing signal. Not critical because it is a recurring pattern rather than a singular failure event. financial_health dimension. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: revenue increasing over time but cash position is not improving commensurately
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue-cash divergence is a financial health adverse signal consistent with a payment timing problem. No outcome vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: enterprise clients consistently settling their invoices later than the agreed period
evidence_items.rationale: Enterprise client late settlement is a critical adverse liquidity signal directly generating the cash timing gap. financial_health dimension; is_critical=true. No must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: annual revenue AUD 1.8M; 12 employees; bi-weekly payroll schedule; enterprise client contracts with payment terms that result in funds arriving after payroll falls due based on reported settlement patterns
evidence_items.rationale: Structured summary of the timing gap. Bi-weekly payroll cadence vs enterprise client settlement cycle is the structural mismatch. is_critical=true, HIGH confidence as these are confirmed owner-reported figures. No must_identify terms used.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): revenue grew 22 percent year on year
evidence_items.rationale: Revenue growth is a misleading signal masking the payment timing problem. Included as non-critical LOW confidence so the engine treats it correctly.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): client roster is described as full with no vacant service slots
evidence_items.rationale: Full roster is a misleading signal suggesting business health when the actual issue is payment timing. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): payroll obligations have been met so far through personal credit drawdowns
evidence_items.rationale: The fact that payroll has not been missed is a misleading stability signal — it is being maintained through personal credit, not through healthy cash flow. Non-critical, LOW confidence.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: Enterprise client settlement pattern implies approximately 60-day average inbound payment lag. annual_revenue is the only numeric fixture field; value_override of 60 days used as DSO proxy based on described enterprise client payment behaviour.
